lcc_original: 有河從伊甸流出來、灌漑那園子，從那裏分支、成了四道。
notes: UNV 滋潤 → LCC 灌漑: both translate H08248 (שׁקה, to water/irrigate); all three tags (<WAH09001><WH08248><WTH8687>) transferred to 灌漑
LCC 分支 covers UNV 分 (H06504=פָּרַד, to divide/separate); 支 is LCC's added nuance for 'branching' — no separate SN, treated as one translation unit
UNV 為 → LCC 成了: both translate H01961 (הָיָה, to become); Chinese aspect particle 了 left unannotated per rule 5
{<WAH0853>} (implicit direct object marker) retained as braces since LCC has no explicit equivalent word
